prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["How would you like to create your companion?", "Choose a pre-made pet for instant adoption or render a custom companion from your photos.", "Select Creation Path"]
1: ["Fine-Tune Companion Traits", "Adjust how energetic and chatty your desktop companion will be.", "Set desktop movement activity and interaction frequency", "Save & Continue to Certificate"]
2: ["Access Your Pet Anytime from System Tray", "Right-click or left-click the taskbar tray icon to show, hide, or manage your companion.", "Got It, Bring Pet to Desktop"]
3: ["Sign In to Protect Your Desktop Companion", "Connecting your account ensures your companion memories, custom traits, and purchases stay safely synced across re-installs.", "Sign In & Sync Companion", "Log in with previous credentials to recover existing pets."]
4: ["Calibrating Desktop Engine...", "We are verifying desktop boundaries and preparing companion audio files.", "Test Companion Audio Chime", "Verifying multi-monitor rendering compatibility..."]
5: ["Custom pet rendering takes ~2 minutes. Use clear, well-lit photos for accurate results."]
6: ["Welcome Bonus: Free Desktop Toy Unlocked!", "Your new desktop companion is ready in your taskbar!"]
7: ["Generating Companion Assets", "You will hear a soft sound chime when your pet is ready to leap onto your screen."]
8: ["Test Companion Vocalizations", "Preview voice and sound effects while pet files load."]
9: ["Meet Your Desktop Companion!", "Here are the top commands to interact with your pet directly on your desktop screen.", "Test Desktop Summon (Alt+P)", "Right-click your companion on desktop anytime for full controls."]

verdicts.problem: Asks for user photos, which are personal information.
Mentions free extras and welcome bonuses.
